identity.name: Langfuse
identity.one_liner: LLM engineering platform for observability, evals, prompt management, datasets, and traces.
identity.short_description: Langfuse is a source-available LLM engineering platform that helps teams observe, evaluate, and improve LLM and agent applications with traces, metrics, prompts, datasets, and integrations.

positioning.why_it_matters: Agent products need more than a model call. They need traces, evaluations, prompt versions, and production feedback loops. Langfuse is one of the most visible open LLM observability stacks for that layer.
